    JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

    FROM order_payments

           MAX(d.order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_purchase_timestamp,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           SUM(p.paid_cents) AS total_spend_cents
    FROM delivered_orders AS d
    LEFT JOIN payments_by_order AS p ON p.order_id = d.order_id
    GROUP BY d.customer_unique_id
), recency AS (
    -- Recency is elapsed days from the customer's latest delivered-order purchase
    -- to the latest delivered-order purchase timestamp in the dataset.
    SELECT *,
           JULIANDAY(MAX(latest_purchase_timestamp) OVER ())
               - JULIANDAY(latest_purchase_timestamp) AS recency_days
    FROM customer_totals

    -- Best to worst: fewer days, more orders, and higher total spend.
    -- Ties share a percentile. Missing spend gets no monetary score.
    SELECT *,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY recency_days) AS r_pct,
           CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS f_pct,
           CASE WHEN total_spend_cents IS NOT NULL THEN
               CUME_DIST() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY (total_spend_cents IS NULL)
                   ORDER BY total_spend_cents DESC
               )
           END AS m_pct
    FROM recency
), scores AS (
    -- Inclusive percentile cutoffs: 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, and 100%.
    SELECT *,
           CASE WHEN r_pct <= 0.20 THEN 1 WHEN r_pct <= 0.40 THEN 2
                WHEN r_pct <= 0.60 THEN 3 WHEN r_pct <= 0.80 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS r,
           (CASE WHEN f_pct <= 0.20 THEN 1 WHEN f_pct <= 0.40 THEN 2
                 WHEN f_pct <= 0.60 THEN 3 WHEN f_pct <= 0.80 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END)
           + (CASE WHEN m_pct IS NULL THEN NULL
                   WHEN m_pct <= 0.20 THEN 1 WHEN m_pct <= 0.40 THEN 2
                   WHEN m_pct <= 0.60 THEN 3 WHEN m_pct <= 0.80 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) AS fm
    FROM percentiles

           CASE

               WHEN r = 1       AND fm BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
               WHEN r = 2       AND fm BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
               WHEN r = 3       AND fm BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
           END AS rfm_segment
    FROM scores

           rfm_segment,
           total_spend_cents / (100.0 * order_count) AS customer_average,

JOIN scoring_results AS sr ON sr.race_id = r.race_id AND sr.driver_id = s.driver_id
JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = sr.constructor_id
WHERE s.points_rank = 1
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, c.name ASC, c.constructor_id ASC
LIMIT 5;
